+2.
+Modern digital signature algorithms such as EdDSA and ML-DSA use the same
+name for both the key and signature algorithms.
+Only the signature algorithm with the same name can be used with a given
+key algorithm.
+The specific signature parameter set (for example, Ed25519 or Ed448 for
+EdDSA) is the same as that of the key.
+.PP
+If a key algorithm is not listed in this table, the \f[V].DSA\f[R] block
+file extension is always used.
+.PP
